author: claude
summary: Task 002 of the voices-variants-round2 plan: consolidates VoiceCatalogCard's actions. Build is now the sole always-visible action; default status renders as a star (top-left) instead of a text pill; the kebab (top-right) now holds Rename, Export, Set as App Default, and Delete; Play is a hover/focus-reveal overlay directly on the avatar, kept keyboard/touch-reachable per INV-FOCUS (opacity-gated, never display:none, real always-tabbable button).

files.change: Removed the direct Play/Set-as-App-Default/Delete buttons from the actions row (Build is now the only entry there). Added the avatar play overlay button. Replaced the default text-pill badge with a star span. ActionMenu items array grew from 2 (Rename, Export) to 4, adding Set as App Default (disabled: hasDefaultProfile) and Delete (isDestructive), grouped behind dividers.

Replaced .voice-catalog-card__default-badge (text pill) with .voice-catalog-card__default-star (top-left, offset past the bulk-select checkbox). Added .voice-catalog-card__menu (top-right kebab wrapper) and .voice-catalog-card__avatar-play-btn (opacity 0 at rest, 1 on :hover/:focus-visible -- INV-FOCUS).

Updated 5 tests that asserted the old direct-button structure (App-default text badge, direct Set-as-Default/Delete buttons) to assert the new consolidated structure via the file's existing ActionMenu mock (data-testid="menu-item-{label}"). Reframed the former 'Delete is NOT in the overflow menu' test into 'Delete IS in the overflow menu' (the design intentionally reversed).

flow_impact: Fourth task landed in the voices-variants-round2 plan. Known outstanding item from task 004 (MultiSelect chip-remove keyboard accessibility) still pending the mandatory adversarial review pass.
